title: The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 3
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: A third volume in the supplied edition of Blavatsky's Secret Doctrine. It continues the collection's comparative treatment of religious symbolism, spiritual cosmology and esoteric interpretation; volume divisions depend on the edition.
